body.statement: For a row-wise independent triangular array of centered random vectors of fixed finite dimension, convergence of the summed covariance matrices together with the Lindeberg condition implies convergence in distribution of the row sums to the centered normal law with the limiting covariance.

source.verbatim_statement: For each n let Y_n,1, ..., Y_n,k_n be independent random vectors with finite variances such that sum from i=1 to k_n of E ||Y_n,i||^2 1{||Y_n,i|| > epsilon} tends to 0, for every epsilon > 0, and sum from i=1 to k_n of Cov Y_n,i tends to Sigma. Then the sequence sum from i=1 to k_n of (Y_n,i - E Y_n,i) converges in distribution to a normal N(0, Sigma) distribution.

attestation.note: Transcribed from the Cambridge University Press digital preview of Asymptotic Statistics, Proposition 2.27, printed page 20 (preview PDF pages 37-38), https://api.pageplace.de/preview/DT0400.9781107266308_A23760354/preview-9781107266308_A23760354.pdf.
